premise: On a cloudy morning Gull follows the fishing boat hoping for something tasty, but the net comes up full of nothing but seaweed, and Seaweed waves to her 'cousin'.
inspiration: The fisherman's-net folk tale (what will the net bring up?) with no wish and no greed: the catch is a cousin, and a laugh.
lesson: Not every surprise is the one you wanted, and that can be funny.

en-US.title: The Net Full of Surprises
en-US.text: {seaweed:enter} {canvas:clouds 0.6 30s} [softly] It was a grey, cloudy morning. Soft clouds drifted over the bay. {fishing-boat:enter} {fishing-boat:go to sea} Chug, chug… the fishing boat came out across the water. {fishing-boat:float loop 0.2} {seagull:enter} Gull flew after it, {seagull:go to fishing-boat} [excited] hoping for something tasty. {seagull:face happy} The boat stopped. {fishing-boat:live net} Up came the net, dripping and heavy. {seagull:live squawk} {sfx:squawk} Gull squawked: what's in it? What's in it? [short pause] {seagull:face surprised} Weed. Just a big, wet, green tangle of weed. {seagull:face sad} [sighs] Not far away, Seaweed {seaweed:face happy} giggled. [playfully] Oh, look! That's my cousin! {seaweed:live sway} She swayed hello. {seagull:face happy} {seagull:live laugh} [laughs] Gull laughed so much she forgot all about being hungry. {fishing-boat:pulse} The fishing boat let the weed slip gently back into the water… {seaweed:live wave} and Seaweed waved until it was gone.

es-ES.title: La red llena de sorpresas
es-ES.text: {seaweed:enter} {canvas:clouds 0.6 30s} [softly] Era una mañana gris y nublada. Unas nubes suaves pasaban sobre la bahía. {fishing-boat:enter} {fishing-boat:go to sea} Chuc, chuc… la barca de pesca salió por el agua. {fishing-boat:float loop 0.2} {seagull:enter} Gaviota voló detrás, {seagull:go to fishing-boat} [excited] esperando algo rico. {seagull:face happy} La barca se paró. {fishing-boat:live net} Subió la red, chorreando y pesada. {seagull:live squawk} {sfx:squawk} Gaviota graznó: ¿qué hay? ¿Qué hay? [short pause] {seagull:face surprised} Algas. Solo una gran maraña verde de algas. {seagull:face sad} [sighs] No muy lejos, Alga {seaweed:face happy} se rió. [playfully] ¡Anda, mira! ¡Son mis primas! {seaweed:live sway} Se meció para saludar. {seagull:face happy} {seagull:live laugh} [laughs] Gaviota se rió tanto que se le olvidó el hambre. {fishing-boat:pulse} La barca devolvió las algas al agua con cuidado… {seaweed:live wave} y Alga las saludó hasta que se perdieron de vista.

ja-JP.title: あみの なかは なあに？
ja-JP.text: {seaweed:enter}{canvas:clouds 0.6 30s}[softly]はいいろの、くもり空の朝です。やわらかな雲が、海の上を、ゆっくりながれていきます。{fishing-boat:enter}{fishing-boat:go to sea}ポン、ポン…漁船が、海へ出ていきました。{fishing-boat:float loop 0.2}{seagull:enter}カモメさんが、あとをおいかけます。{seagull:go to fishing-boat}[excited]おいしいもの、もらえるかな？{seagull:face happy}ふねが、とまりました。{fishing-boat:live net}ぽたぽたしずくをたらして、おもたいあみが、あがってきます。{seagull:live squawk}{sfx:squawk}「クワーッ！なにかな？なにかな？」 [short pause]{seagull:face surprised}…わかめ。ぬれて、もじゃもじゃの、みどりのわかめだけ。{seagull:face sad}[sighs]がっかり…すこしはなれたところで、海藻が{seaweed:face happy}くすくすわらいました。[playfully]「あら、見て！わたしの、いとこだわ！」 {seaweed:live sway}ゆらゆらゆれて、こんにちは。{seagull:face happy}{seagull:live laugh}[laughs]カモメさんは、おなかがすいていたのもわすれて、大わらい。{fishing-boat:pulse}漁船は、わかめを、そうっと水にかえしてあげました…{seaweed:live wave}海藻は、見えなくなるまで、手をふっていました。

de-DE.title: Ein Netz voller Überraschungen
de-DE.text: {seaweed:enter} {canvas:clouds 0.6 30s} [softly] Es war ein grauer, wolkiger Morgen. Weiche Wolken zogen über die Bucht. {fishing-boat:enter} {fishing-boat:go to sea} Tuck, tuck… das Fischerboot fuhr hinaus aufs Meer. {fishing-boat:float loop 0.2} {seagull:enter} Die Möwe flog hinterher, {seagull:go to fishing-boat} [excited] denn vielleicht gab es ja etwas Leckeres. {seagull:face happy} Das Boot hielt an. {fishing-boat:live net} Hoch kam das Netz, tropfnass und schwer. {seagull:live squawk} {sfx:squawk} Die Möwe kreischte: „Was ist drin? Was ist drin?“ [short pause] {seagull:face surprised} Tang. Nur ein großes, nasses, grünes Knäuel Tang. {seagull:face sad} [sighs] Nicht weit weg {seaweed:face happy} kicherte der Seetang. [playfully] „Oh, schaut mal! Das ist ja mein Cousin!“ {seaweed:live sway} Er wiegte sich zum Gruß. {seagull:face happy} {seagull:live laugh} [laughs] Die Möwe lachte so sehr, dass sie ihren Hunger ganz vergaß. {fishing-boat:pulse} Das Fischerboot ließ den Tang sanft zurück ins Wasser gleiten… {seaweed:live wave} und der Seetang winkte, bis sein Cousin verschwunden war.

fr-FR.title: Un filet plein de surprises
fr-FR.text: {seaweed:enter} {canvas:clouds 0.6 30s} [softly] C’était un matin gris et nuageux. De gros nuages tout doux passaient au-dessus de la baie. {fishing-boat:enter} {fishing-boat:go to sea} Teuf, teuf… le bateau de pêche a pris la mer. {fishing-boat:float loop 0.2} {seagull:enter} Mouette l’a suivi en volant, {seagull:go to fishing-boat} [excited] en espérant un bon petit quelque chose. {seagull:face happy} Le bateau s’est arrêté. {fishing-boat:live net} Le filet est remonté, lourd et tout dégoulinant. {seagull:live squawk} {sfx:squawk} Mouette criait : « Qu’est-ce qu’il y a dedans ? Qu’est-ce qu’il y a dedans ? » [short pause] {seagull:face surprised} Des algues. Rien qu’un gros paquet d’algues vertes, tout mouillé, tout emmêlé. {seagull:face sad} [sighs] Pas très loin, Algue {seaweed:face happy} a pouffé de rire. [playfully] « Oh, regardez ! Ce sont mes cousines ! » {seaweed:live sway} Elle s’est balancée pour leur dire bonjour. {seagull:face happy} {seagull:live laugh} [laughs] Mouette a tellement ri qu’elle en a oublié sa faim. {fishing-boat:pulse} Le bateau de pêche a laissé les algues glisser tout doucement dans l’eau… {seaweed:live wave} et Algue leur a fait coucou jusqu’à ce qu’elles disparaissent.

it-IT.title: La rete piena di sorprese
it-IT.text: {seaweed:enter} {canvas:clouds 0.6 30s} [softly] Era una mattina grigia e nuvolosa. Nuvole morbide passavano sopra la baia. {fishing-boat:enter} {fishing-boat:go to sea} Tuf, tuf… il peschereccio ha preso il largo. {fishing-boat:float loop 0.2} {seagull:enter} Gabbiano gli è volato dietro, {seagull:go to fishing-boat} [excited] sperando in qualcosa di buono. {seagull:face happy} La barca si è fermata. {fishing-boat:live net} Ecco che sale la rete, pesante e gocciolante. {seagull:live squawk} {sfx:squawk} Gabbiano ha strillato: «Che c'è dentro? Che c'è dentro?» [short pause] {seagull:face surprised} Alghe. Solo un grosso groviglio di alghe, verde e bagnato. {seagull:face sad} [sighs] Poco lontano, Alga {seaweed:face happy} ha ridacchiato. [playfully] «Oh, guarda! Sono le mie cugine!» {seaweed:live sway} Ha ondeggiato per salutarle. {seagull:face happy} {seagull:live laugh} [laughs] Gabbiano ha riso così tanto che si è scordato della fame. {fishing-boat:pulse} Il peschereccio ha lasciato scivolare piano le alghe di nuovo in acqua… {seaweed:live wave} e Alga le ha salutate finché non sono sparite.

zh-TW.title: 網子裡的驚喜
zh-TW.text: {seaweed:enter}{canvas:clouds 0.6 30s}[softly]那是一個灰灰的、陰陰的早上。軟軟的雲，慢慢飄過海灣。{fishing-boat:enter}{fishing-boat:go to sea}噗、噗……漁船開出來，開到海上。{fishing-boat:float loop 0.2}{seagull:enter}海鷗跟在後面飛，{seagull:go to fishing-boat}[excited]想討點好吃的。{seagull:face happy}漁船停了下來。{fishing-boat:live net}網子拉上來了，重重的，還滴著水。{seagull:live squawk}{sfx:squawk}海鷗大叫：「裡面有什麼？裡面有什麼？」 [short pause]{seagull:face surprised}是海藻。只有一大團濕濕的、綠綠的、纏成一團的海藻。{seagull:face sad}[sighs]不遠的地方，海草{seaweed:face happy}咯咯地笑了。[playfully]「哎呀，你們看！那是我的表姊妹耶！」 {seaweed:live sway}她搖一搖，打個招呼。{seagull:face happy}{seagull:live laugh}[laughs]海鷗笑得好開心，連肚子餓都忘記了。{fishing-boat:pulse}漁船把海藻輕輕地放回水裡……{seaweed:live wave}海草一直揮手，揮到看不見為止。

zh-HK.title: 滿是驚喜的魚網
zh-HK.text: {seaweed:enter}{canvas:clouds 0.6 30s}[softly]這是一個灰灰的、多雲的早上。軟綿綿的雲，在海灣上空慢慢飄過。{fishing-boat:enter}{fishing-boat:go to sea}噗、噗……漁船在水面上駛了出去。{fishing-boat:float loop 0.2}{seagull:enter}海鷗跟在後面飛，{seagull:go to fishing-boat}[excited]想找點好吃的。{seagull:face happy}漁船停了下來。{fishing-boat:live net}網拉上來了，濕淋淋的，重甸甸的。{seagull:live squawk}{sfx:squawk}海鷗呀呀叫：「有乜嘢呀？有乜嘢呀？」 [short pause]{seagull:face surprised}原來是水草。只是一大團濕濕的、綠綠的、纏成一堆的水草。{seagull:face sad}[sighs]不遠處，海草{seaweed:face happy}咯咯地笑了。[playfully]「嘩，你睇！係我嘅表姐妹呀！」 {seaweed:live sway}她搖搖擺擺，打個招呼。{seagull:face happy}{seagull:live laugh}[laughs]海鷗笑個不停，連肚子餓都忘記了。{fishing-boat:pulse}漁船輕輕地把水草放回水裏……{seaweed:live wave}海草一直揮着葉子，直到看不見它們為止。
